_comment: Task pool for the daily Bingo card. Copy this file, edit it, and point BINGO_TASKS_FILE at your copy.

pool: LABEL -> meaning. Labels are shown on the device: printable ASCII, at most 8 characters, each word at most 5 characters (a word must fit a 42 px cell in the 12 px device font), no comma, quote or backslash; a label wraps at its space. Meanings are only shown to the companion.
The pool needs at least 30 labels so a 5x5 card plus re-rolls never runs dry.
fixed: labels that are on every card.
auto: labels the server can tick from check-in events (PASSPORT_CHECKINS_FILE), label -> rule. Rules: up_before_10, bed_before_1, slept_7h, went_out.
checkin_tags: which tag in the check-in file means getting up / going to bed / going out.
fallback_whispers: used when the companion wrote no whisper for the day before the first line is completed (printable ASCII, <= 80 chars).

pool.TEA: had a warm drink instead of coffee
pool.EYES: rested the eyes away from screens
pool.NO SIT: never sat more than 1 hour at a time
pool.PROUD: noticed something to be proud of
pool.DIARY: wrote a few lines in a journal
pool.REPLY: answered a message that was waiting

fallback_whispers: A whole line! I'm grinning at my screen. Proud of you.
Bingo! You took care of yourself today. That's my favourite thing.
Look at you go. Drink one more glass of water for me, ok?
Line complete. Gold star, and a nap if you want one.
You did it. Small things, every one of them counts.
